⚠️ **本卡的行号已被独立复核,并且发现漏了一处** —— 由 #7888 的 dev 在同一文件里作业时顺带测得(本席在派发令里要求他顺手确认,因为原行号来自另一位 dev、从未被证实)。

| | 结论 |
|---|---|
| `~1410` | ✅ **准确**。过期示范位于 `b5e09b21` 的 **1409–1412 行**,在 `measureTestDebt()` 的 docblock 里 |
| ⚠️ 本卡漏掉的 | **同一说法还有第二份拷贝,在 `:500`**,TEST_DEBT 前言中:*「the wholesale glob would pull in `e2e/global-setup.ts` … and bill the test layer 6 errors that are not its own」* |

⇒ **两处一起改,或者都不改。** 只修 1410 那处会留下一份措辞不同、断言相同的过期副本,那比原状更坏 —— 下一个读到 `:500` 的人没有任何线索知道它已被推翻。

顺带记一条本卡的方法论教训:立卡时我照抄了 dev 报的行号并标注「未经本席复核」,那是对的;但我**没有问「这个说法在文件里出现了几次」**。一份过期断言的第二份拷贝,和第一份一样会误导人,而且更难发现。**凡是「某处散文已过期」的卡,立卡时就该带一次全文件计数。**

⛔ 两处都未改动 —— #7888 是账本 diff,按其派发令第 5 条明确不搭车。本卡仍 open,`finding`,未指派。

Finding-grading round: **promoted to `pm:queue`** as an S card, with direction 2 of the card's own list recommended — keep the worked example, mark it historical, naming #8062/PR #8178 as what changed and why the general claim (add hidden test layers one at a time) survived. Rationale: direction 1 requires hunting for a package where the narrow glob is still live (unmeasured, possibly empty set) and direction 3 trades away the concreteness that makes the passage worth its length; direction 2 is cheapest and the historical claim is verifiable (six errors re-measured on `origin/main` @ `7cfe7ad`, recorded on #8062). Dev must confirm the ~line-1410 anchor against `origin/main` before editing — the line number is second-hand by the card's own admission. Type Task, `domain:devx` confirmed. Size/model suggestion: S, subagent, sonnet.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine。

This card was held out of round 1's batch because **PR #8330 (issue #8271) was landing in the same file** and the two must not ride together. #8330 merged at 06:24:48Z. Verified after the merge that #8330 did **not** touch this card's subject — a `+`/`-` scan for `global-setup` across its whole diff returns nothing, so the defect is intact and this card is still valid.

⚠️ **Both line numbers on this card are now stale — do not dispatch against them.** #8330 inserted ~300 lines above these points. Measured on `origin/main` after the merge:

| the card says | actually on `main` now |
|---|---|
| `~1410` | **`:1705`** |
| `:500` | **`:507`** |

Locate them with `grep -n "global-setup.ts" scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` rather than by line number — this file is one of the most-edited in the lane and any number written down has a short shelf life.

**Standing constraint, unchanged: the two occurrences move together or not at all.** They are two halves of one worked example, and fixing one leaves the file self-contradicting.

⚠️ One thing to re-measure before writing anything: the card's premise is that the worked example names a file that no longer has the property it illustrates. #8330 changed what `--re-measure` *does* (it now refreshes the built closure via `refreshBuiltClosure()` rather than merely asserting it). Check whether that changes what the example *should* say, not just where it sits — the prose fix may have a different target now than when the card was filed.
